items.title: Saline Township Data Center for Oracle and OpenAI Now Tops $43 Billion
items.dek: Related Digital keeps building the 1.4-gigawatt facility, with costs rising from $4.8 billion and more than 2,500 short-term construction jobs expected, while residents voice opposition.
items.judge_note: Major new development: project cost has ballooned from $4.8B to $43B, a concrete and dramatic escalation at the Oracle/OpenAI Saline site.
